title: Planet Crisis Response — Earthquake, Azuero Peninsula and Central Panama (October 2026)
description:
On 9 October 2026 a magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck about 39 km northwest of Tonosí, Panama, followed by a sequence of strong aftershocks (including M6.9 and M6.6 the same day). Damage to buildings, road access and landslides were reported across the provinces of Coclé, Herrera, Los Santos and Veraguas.
This catalog contains a pre-event Planet basemap (July–September 2026) covering the full area of interest, and post-event Pelican and PlanetScope imagery from 11 October and SkySat imagery from 14–15 October 2026, including strips over the southern Azuero Peninsula near the epicentre. It is released through the Planet Crisis Response Program.
